name: Sysmon
author: Aziz Uysal
description: CPU, memory, GPU and disk in the bar as small live graphs, each with a detail panel: history graphs, per-core load, temperatures, top processes and volumes.

barWidget.description: Live CPU, memory, GPU and disk readings as small graphs, each opening a detail panel.

schema.label: Readings
schema.description: Choose which readings this widget shows. Leave empty to show them all. Add the widget more than once to place readings in different parts of the bar.

options.label: Disk
options.description: Space used on the system disk

schema.label: Show readings as
schema.description: Graphs draws a small history graph for CPU and GPU, an upright gauge for memory and a capacity bar for disk. Percentages shows each icon with its number. Icons shows the icon alone.
